enchantments.tooltip: Voice of Deceit: Passive: +20 Competence bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, Haggle, and Perform skills.
Charisma +8: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +5 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
This relic is attuned to heroic actions.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
